result.summary: Updates the CI documentation in `ci/README.md` to reflect modern container setups and current CI runner behavior. It updates instructions for multiarch QEMU execution via `tonistiigi/binfmt`, corrects relative paths to `../depends`, removes inaccurate claims about script numbering order, clarifies caching mechanisms, and adds an explanation of dependency pinning policies.
result.problem: Developers referencing CI documentation encounter outdated guidance, including references to an unmaintained multiarch QEMU helper image, inaccurate descriptions of script execution order, and unclear details on caching and dependency pinning rationale.
evidence: Commit fabc10bc59 notes: "Modern container engines ship QEMU by default. So installing qemu-user-static is not always needed. Also, docker.io/multiarch/qemu-user-static hasn't been updated in years and the replacement according to the Docker docs is tonistiigi/binfmt."
Commit fa5de5cd16 notes that scripts are not run in numeric order: "02_run_container.py runs before 01_base_install.sh and some scripts have no number".
result.changed_since_previous: Diff is now available; the commit messages and scope remain unchanged.
result.card: Updates ci/README.md to bring local CI setup instructions and harness descriptions up to date. It replaces unmaintained QEMU binfmt container recommendations with current Docker docs guidance, clarifies relative depends paths and CI caching mechanics, removes inaccurate claims that numbered CI scripts run sequentially, and documents the policy on CI dependency hash pinning. This primarily benefits developers and contributors attempting to reproduce CI test failures locally.

risk.why: Touches only documentation for CI developer setup; cannot affect node operation or test executions.
